+# Publishing the Composer packages
+
+Development takes place on `main` in `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit`. Each directory in
+`packages/` has a public mirror at `https://github.com/k-kinzal/<directory>`.
+Submit these six mirror URLs to [Packagist](https://packagist.org/packages/submit),
+not the monorepo URL. Submit `docgen-php`, `doctest-php`, `guard-php`, and
+`phpunit-ai-reporter` before the PHPStan packages, which depend on them.
+
+The [Split Monorepo workflow](../.github/workflows/split.yml) validates the
+distribution archives and installs all six packages in a fresh consumer project
+on PHP 8.0 and 8.5 before publishing. It runs on pushes to `main`, stable `v*`
+tags, and manual dispatches. Pull requests only run validation.
+
+## What is published
+
+Each mirror contains the committed package directory, with these changes:
+
+- Remove monorepo path repositories and every development lock file.
+- Set internal package dependencies to `dev-main` on main, or `^MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`
+  for a release. All six packages share the same release version.
+- Add documentation, source, and issue tracker URLs to Composer metadata.
+- Add a mirror notice to the README and omit tests and development tool
+  configuration from GitHub distribution archives using `.gitattributes`.
+
+The original manifests and lock files stay in the monorepo for development.
+Do not edit the mirrors: the next synchronization replaces their files. Existing
+commits remain in their history. The existing `doctest-php` repository is reused
+with its earlier history intact.
+
+## Authentication
+
+Each mirror has a write-enabled SSH deploy key named `php-ai-toolkit split`.
+The corresponding private key is a repository Actions secret in the monorepo:
+
+| Mirror | Actions secret |
+| --- | --- |
+| `docgen-php` | `SPLIT_DOCGEN_PHP_SSH_KEY` |
+| `doctest-php` | `SPLIT_DOCTEST_PHP_SSH_KEY` |
+| `guard-php` | `SPLIT_GUARD_PHP_SSH_KEY` |
+| `phpstan-ai-formatter` | `SPLIT_PHPSTAN_AI_FORMATTER_SSH_KEY` |
+| `phpstan-guard-rules` | `SPLIT_PHPSTAN_GUARD_RULES_SSH_KEY` |
+| `phpunit-ai-reporter` | `SPLIT_PHPUNIT_AI_REPORTER_SSH_KEY` |
+
+To rotate a key, generate an Ed25519 key pair, add its public key as a writable
+deploy key on that mirror, replace the matching Actions secret with the private
+key, verify a manual split run, and then remove the old deploy key. Each key can
+write only to its own mirror; the workflow's `GITHUB_TOKEN` only reads the monorepo.
+
+## Releasing
+
+Wait for CI to pass on the intended `main` commit, then create and push an
+annotated stable tag on the monorepo, for example:
+
+```sh
+git tag -a v1.0.0 -m 'Release v1.0.0'
+git push origin v1.0.0
+```
+
+The split workflow creates the same tag in all six mirrors. Tag snapshots do not
+move mirror `main` branches, so publishing an older release cannot roll back
+development. Re-running a tag succeeds if its files already match and fails if
+the tag would change. Publish a new version instead of moving existing tags.
+Wait for each release run to finish before pushing the next release tag.
+
+After the first successful split, submit each mirror on Packagist. Connect the
+[Packagist GitHub hook](https://packagist.org/about#how-to-update-packages) so later
+pushes update the package automatically. Until a stable tag exists, consumers
+must explicitly allow `dev-main` for every toolkit dependency they use.
+
+## Local verification
+
+Run `bash .github/scripts/test-split.sh` with PHP, Composer, Git, jq, and rsync
+installed. It builds archives from `HEAD`, checks Composer publication metadata,
+installs both development and stable distributions, exercises the CLI entry
+points, and tests synchronization against a temporary local Git remote.

# Publishing the Composer packages

Development takes place on `main` in `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit`. Each directory in
`packages/` has a public mirror at `https://github.com/k-kinzal/<directory>`.
Submit these six mirror URLs to [Packagist](https://packagist.org/packages/submit),
not the monorepo URL. Submit `docgen-php`, `doctest-php`, `guard-php`, and
`phpunit-ai-reporter` before the PHPStan packages, which depend on them.

The [Split Monorepo workflow](../.github/workflows/split.yml) validates the
distribution archives and installs all six packages in a fresh consumer project
on PHP 8.0 and 8.5 before publishing. It runs on pushes to `main`, stable `v*`
tags, and manual dispatches. Pull requests only run validation.

## What is published

Each mirror contains the committed package directory, with these changes:

- Remove monorepo path repositories and every development lock file.
- Set internal package dependencies to `dev-main` on main, or `^MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`
  for a release. All six packages share the same release version.
- Add documentation, source, and issue tracker URLs to Composer metadata.
- Add a mirror notice to the README and omit tests and development tool
  configuration from GitHub distribution archives using `.gitattributes`.

The original manifests and lock files stay in the monorepo for development.
Do not edit the mirrors: the next synchronization replaces their files. Existing
commits remain in their history. The existing `doctest-php` repository is reused
with its earlier history intact.

## Authentication

Each mirror has a write-enabled SSH deploy key named `php-ai-toolkit split`.
The corresponding private key is a repository Actions secret in the monorepo:

| Mirror | Actions secret |
| --- | --- |
| `docgen-php` | `SPLIT_DOCGEN_PHP_SSH_KEY` |
| `doctest-php` | `SPLIT_DOCTEST_PHP_SSH_KEY` |
| `guard-php` | `SPLIT_GUARD_PHP_SSH_KEY` |
| `phpstan-ai-formatter` | `SPLIT_PHPSTAN_AI_FORMATTER_SSH_KEY` |
| `phpstan-guard-rules` | `SPLIT_PHPSTAN_GUARD_RULES_SSH_KEY` |
| `phpunit-ai-reporter` | `SPLIT_PHPUNIT_AI_REPORTER_SSH_KEY` |

To rotate a key, generate an Ed25519 key pair, add its public key as a writable
deploy key on that mirror, replace the matching Actions secret with the private
key, verify a manual split run, and then remove the old deploy key. Each key can
write only to its own mirror; the workflow's `GITHUB_TOKEN` only reads the monorepo.

## Releasing

Wait for CI to pass on the intended `main` commit, then create and push an
annotated stable tag on the monorepo, for example:

```sh
git tag -a v1.0.0 -m 'Release v1.0.0'
git push origin v1.0.0
```

The split workflow creates the same tag in all six mirrors. Tag snapshots do not
move mirror `main` branches, so publishing an older release cannot roll back
development. Re-running a tag succeeds if its files already match and fails if
the tag would change. Publish a new version instead of moving existing tags.
Wait for each release run to finish before pushing the next release tag.

After the first successful split, submit each mirror on Packagist. Connect the
[Packagist GitHub hook](https://packagist.org/about#how-to-update-packages) so later
pushes update the package automatically. Until a stable tag exists, consumers
must explicitly allow `dev-main` for every toolkit dependency they use.

## Local verification

Run `bash .github/scripts/test-split.sh` with PHP, Composer, Git, jq, and rsync
installed. It builds archives from `HEAD`, checks Composer publication metadata,
installs both development and stable distributions, exercises the CLI entry
points, and tests synchronization against a temporary local Git remote.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' EXIT

# Use real Git archives as Composer dist packages, including export-ignore rules.
# Both release and dev dependencies must resolve without the monorepo path repos.
for version in dev-main 1.0.0; do
  stage="$test_dir/$version"
  mkdir -p "$stage/consumer"
  definitions="$stage/packages.jsonl"
  tag=''
  if [ "$version" != dev-main ]; then
    tag="v$version"
  fi
  for manifest in "$root"/packages/*/composer.json; do
    package="$(basename "$(dirname "$manifest")")"
    output="$stage/$package"
    bash "$root/.github/scripts/prepare-package.sh" "$package" "$output" "$tag"
    git -C "$output" init --quiet --initial-branch=main
    git -C "$output" add --all
    git -C "$output" -c user.name=Test -c user.email=test@example.com commit --quiet -m Package
    git -C "$output" archive --format=zip --output="$stage/$package.zip" HEAD
    jq --arg version "$version" --arg url "$stage/$package.zip" '
      . + {version: $version, dist: {type: "zip", url: $url}}
    ' "$output/composer.json" >> "$definitions"
  done
  jq -s --arg version "$version" '{
    name: "test/split-consumer",
    require: (map({key: .name, value: $version}) | from_entries),
    repositories: [{type: "package", package: .}],
    config: {"allow-plugins": false}
  }' "$definitions" > "$stage/consumer/composer.json"
  composer update --working-dir="$stage/consumer" --no-interaction --no-plugins --no-scripts --prefer-dist
  composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$stage/consumer"
  "$stage/consumer/vendor/bin/guard" --help >/dev/null
  "$stage/consumer/vendor/bin/docgen" --help >/dev/null
  php -r '
    require $argv[1] . "/vendor/autoload.php";
    foreach (glob($argv[1] . "/vendor/k-kinzal/*/composer.json") as $file) {
        $manifest = json_decode(file_get_contents($file), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        if (isset($manifest["repositories"]) || is_file(dirname($file) . "/composer.lock")) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Monorepo development configuration leaked into " . $file);
        }
        if (is_dir(dirname($file) . "/tests") || !is_file(dirname($file) . "/LICENSE")) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Incorrect distribution contents in " . $file);
        }
    }
  ' "$stage/consumer"
done

# Exercise actual pushes locally: updates, unchanged reruns, immutable releases,
# and releasing an older snapshot without rolling main back.
git init --quiet --bare --initial-branch=main "$test_dir/remote.git"
git clone --quiet "$test_dir/remote.git" "$test_dir/mirror"
git -C "$test_dir/mirror" -c user.name=Test -c user.email=test@example.com commit --quiet --allow-empty -m Initialize
git -C "$test_dir/mirror" push --quiet origin main
snapshot="$test_dir/dev-main/docgen-php"
rm -rf "$snapshot/.git"
bash "$root/.github/scripts/push-package.sh" "$snapshot" "$test_dir/mirror" first
first="$(git -C "$test_dir/mirror" rev-parse HEAD)"
bash "$root/.github/scripts/push-package.sh" "$snapshot" "$test_dir/mirror" first
test "$first" = "$(git -C "$test_dir/mirror" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'Newer main snapshot' >> "$snapshot/README.md"
bash "$root/.github/scripts/push-package.sh" "$snapshot" "$test_dir/mirror" second
main="$(git -C "$test_dir/mirror" rev-parse HEAD)"
release="$test_dir/1.0.0/docgen-php"

bash "$root/.github/scripts/push-package.sh" "$release" "$test_dir/mirror" first v1.0.0
test "$main" = "$(git --git-dir="$test_dir/remote.git" rev-parse main)"

if bash "$root/.github/scripts/push-package.sh" "$release" "$test_dir/mirror" first v1.0.0; then

fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

package_dir="${1:?Usage: push-package.sh PACKAGE_DIR CHECKOUT SOURCE_SHA [TAG]}"
checkout="${2:?Pass the split repository checkout.}"
source_sha="${3:?Pass the source monorepo commit.}"
tag="${4:-}"

rsync -a --delete --exclude '/.git/' "$package_dir/" "$checkout/"
cd "$checkout"
git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
git add --all
tree="$(git write-tree)"
message="Sync from k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit@$source_sha"

if [ -n "$tag" ]; then
  # A release may refer to an older source commit. Publish its snapshot as a tag
  # without moving main backwards or replacing an already published release.
  if git rev-parse --verify "refs/tags/$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ "$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/$tag^{tree}")" != "$tree" ]; then
      echo "Tag '$tag' already contains different files; publish a new version instead." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "Tag '$tag' already contains this package."
    exit 0
  fi
  commit="$(git commit-tree "$tree" -p HEAD -m "$message")"
  git tag -a "$tag" "$commit" -m "$tag from php-ai-toolkit@$source_sha"
  git push origin "refs/tags/$tag"
else
  if git diff --cached --quiet; then
    echo 'The split repository already contains this package.'
    exit 0
  fi
  git commit -m "$message"
  git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/main
fi

session_env = dict(os.environ, GH_CONFIG_DIR='/Users/ab/.config/gh')
def api(path, method='GET', body=None):
    args = ['gh', 'api', path, '--method', method]
    if body is not None:
        args += ['--input', '-']
    result = subprocess.run(args, input=json.dumps(body) if body is not None else None,
                            text=True, capture_output=True, env=session_env, check=True)
    return json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout.strip() else None

for manifest in sorted(pathlib.Path('packages').glob('*/composer.json')):
    data = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
    package = manifest.parent.name
    repository = f'k-kinzal/{package}'
    description = data['description'] + '. Read-only mirror of k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit.'
    if package == 'doctest-php':
        api(f'repos/{repository}', 'PATCH', {'archived': False, 'description': description,

        print(f'Reused {repository}; previous history preserved.', flush=True)

        api('user/repos', 'POST', {'name': package, 'description': description, 'private': False,
            'auto_init': True, 'has_issues': False, 'has_wiki': False, 'has_projects': False,
            'homepage': 'https://k-kinzal.github.io/php-ai-toolkit/'})
        print(f'Created https://github.com/{repository}', flush=True)
    repo = api(f'repos/{repository}')

        raise RuntimeError(f'{repository} has unexpected default branch {repo["default_branch"]}')
    secret_name = 'SPLIT_' + package.upper().replace('-', '_') + '_SSH_KEY'
    if secret_name in secrets:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{secret_name} already exists; inspect before rotating.')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='php-toolkit-deploy-') as temporary:
        key = pathlib.Path(temporary) / 'deploy'
        subprocess.run(['ssh-keygen', '-q', '-t', 'ed25519', '-N', '', '-C', f'php-ai-toolkit split {package}', '-f', str(key)], check=True)

        subprocess.run(['gh', 'secret', 'set', secret_name, '--repo', 'k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit'],
                       input=key.read_bytes(), capture_output=True, env=session_env, check=True)
